AUTHOR: Allken
TITLE: Fish species identification using a convolutional neural network trained on synthetic data
REGION: Norwegian Sea, transect at 65.83°N from Norwegian coast to Iceland (IESNS 2017 survey)
SPECIES: Blue whiting (Micromesistius poutassou), Atlantic herring (Clupea harengus), Atlantic mackerel (Scomber scombrus)
DATA: Own Deep Vision in-trawl stereo camera images (1,216,914 image pairs from 20 trawl stations, May 2017); synthetic training images composited from 10–70 cropped fish; 3000 real images for validation (600) and test (2400)
V_EV: Introduction: 'Each image is accompanied by information about GPS position, time, and depth.' Table 1 lists headrope depth per station; no visibility measurement
D2: Test 2400 real images (800/species); validation 20% of 3000-image balanced real set; training synthetic
D_EV: Validation and testing: 'a total of 3000 images obtained from the Deep Vision survey ... 20% of this dataset was kept as validation data' (image-level allocation)
R_EV: Validation and testing: 'we tested our network on a test dataset consisting of 2400 real images, 800 from each species' (same single survey)
C_EV: Results/Fig. 5: 'the prediction scores can also be interpreted as the classifier’s confidence'; 'the fraction of misclassified images decreases with increasing confidence threshold'
E_EV: Results: 'The best accuracy (94.1%) on the test dataset' — only classification accuracy/confusion matrix reported; no ecological variable
ARCH: Inception v3 (Keras/TensorFlow), fine-tuned, global average pooling + dropout, 3-class softmax; trained on synthetic composite images
METR: Classification accuracy, confusion matrix, accuracy vs retained fraction by softmax threshold
NOTE: Deep Vision camera chamber is underwater between trawl and codend (in situ, not on-deck) -> INCL=Y. ENV coded NR (pelagic open-water Norwegian Sea; no matching category). D1: split unit is individual images drawn from one survey pool (randomness not explicitly stated; no station/haul separation; unclear whether synthetic-source crops overlap test images). C: image-level classification but softmax confidence analysed: Fig. 5 left shows misclassified fraction per prediction-score bin (coded C2='기타' as a binned confidence-vs-error/reliability-type analysis) and Fig. 5 right shows accuracy vs retained data when low-score images are discarded (coded C4=Y as threshold reject). A stricter reading (C2=없음, C4=N) would give C_ALL=P via C1 + threshold sensitivity. V3=Y based on strobe lighting / 'regular background and lighting' in Discussion; V2 from Table 1 headrope depth.
